Resolves #21705

Adds `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` for standalone example toolbars. With two available themes it switches in one click. With three or more it opens a keyboard-operable radio menu that marks the effective viewport theme. Both paths use the existing circular reveal when supported and allowed by the user's motion preference. The glyphs use CSS and work without icon fonts.

Evidence: L3 (actual browser fixture with App Worker and native reveal) → L3 required (theme choice, keyboard, pointer, and compact presentation). Residual: none for the shared component.

Related: #21704 · #21706 · #21707 · #21708

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/component/button/ThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` renders the control without icon fonts and observes its glyph at phone width. |
| AC-2 | The browser spec boots in Neo Dark via URL, switches by click and Space, and checks the first circular reveal keyframe against the actual click. |
| AC-3 | The browser spec opens all five choices, checks the selected radio item, switches using pointer and keyboard, restores trigger focus, and observes external viewport theme changes. |
| AC-4 | The browser spec verifies a 390 × 844 viewport with the visible glyph, hidden visual text, accessible name, keyboard focus ring, and room for the adjacent toolbar control. |
| AC-5 | All five development themes built. Theme surfaces, token-file and variable checks passed. The focused component tests and the button unit suite passed. |

## Deltas from ticket

The menu uses Neo's list navigation and dismissal. The rendered viewport's theme remains the source of truth. The switcher explicitly honors reduced motion and only offers themes declared for the target window. It leaves demo toolbar integration to the three rollout leaves.

## Test Evidence

The browser fixture exercises real Engine instances, browser focus and the native View Transition API. It passed 4/4 at the rebased head and 8/8 on a repeated run before the equivalent rebase. The button unit suite passed 47/47 at the rebased head. Dedicated tests cover reveal transport rejection, reduced motion and an external theme change during capture.

The fixture shows the theme control alongside an existing toolbar action at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844. Frame critique: the compact view retains the glyph and visible focus ring. The five-choice menu aligns to the trailing trigger and returns focus after selection or Escape.

Engine hosts no `agent-preflight` script. Commit hooks and local theme checks passed.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Exercise the resulting controls in the published standalone examples as #21706, #21707 and #21708 land.
